summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes shipped 727KB obfuscated payload
details: package.json declares preinstall = 'node setup.mjs'. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from GitHub releases for the host platform, extracts it, chmods it 0755, and then invokes it against math_init.js (falling back to any Bun already on PATH). math_init.js is a ~727KB single-line, string-array + index-rotation obfuscated Bun-CJS bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`, WV8StW rotator, large mangled constant table) with no corresponding source in the package's TypeScript tree. The package's advertised purpose is a React JSON-render component catalog, which has no need for a second language runtime or a large opaque init script. The alternate-runtime execution path also bypasses Node-focused install-time scanners. Installing the package causes the obfuscated payload to run with the installer's privileges on every install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
